basic_info.description: Investment opportunity with upside potential in terms of both income and condition. The new owner can establish market rents for all 3 vacant residential units, a rare opportunity in SF.  The retail store, occupied by Great Cuts on Geary, is on a mo.-to-mo. basis and they would like to stay.  The $13K Markoff pest report can be incorporated into value-add improvements. Extremely competitive GRM & Cap. rate. Ideal for an investor in a Sec. 1031 exchange, wishing to add/diversify portfolio, or a new investor looking for wealth building opportunity.
